fusions.name: Cast Off
fusions.desc: Casts a hawk from your fist at the first enemy in its path, dealing 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Downstroke
fusions.desc: Fans a spread palm, sending a gust 4 tiles ahead that deals 11 wind damage to everything in it, knocks each target back 3 tiles and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip the Jesses
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions that hold or stop you, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hooded Hawk
fusions.desc: Calls a hawk familiar that fights beside you, striking an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second.
